text_block_list.text:
The heated race came to an end. Defeating 
Biwa Hayahide and Narita Taishin, Winning 
Ticket savored the joy of victory.

At the same time, however, she realized 
she was feeling overwhelmed by Narita 
Taishin's fiercely intense running.

Managing to shake off her self-doubt, 
Winning Ticket fired herself up so that 
she wouldn't lose in the Nippon Derby 
either.
